verdict.rationale: Ultrametric's `init` writes its own prebuilt SKILL.md files for Codex and Claude Code. Its templates cover company-profile and assessment guides, not skill authoring. Nothing in the evidence describes a spec, template, or meta-skill that lets an agent author and package a new skill end to end. Installing a vendor-supplied skill is an adjacent capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can author and package a new skill end to end by following the project's own spec, template, or meta-skill
